title: scribble-eval-concoction: ad-hoc rubric + quick regression log
body:
Quick, messy scratchpad from a 90-minute session where I tried to capture small heuristics and a few reproducible regression examples. Not polished; meant for handoff to Samir/Noelle and to keep a trace of hypotheses.

Context:
- Running nightly smoke on hosted-api:v2 (seq len 512) spotted spike in factuality regressions for 'finance-summary' prompt set. Baseline (2024-12-20) vs current (2025-01-12).
- Suspect change: new fused-attention kernel rollout (PR 512) + a quantization tweak for int8 path.

Ad-hoc rubric (for quick triage) — three axes, 0-3 each (augment later):
- Faithfulness (0: hallucinated facts, 3: fully supported by prompt/known facts)
- Concision (0: verbose/irrelevant, 3: tight on-target)
- Token-coherence (0: broken tokens/garbled, 3: fluent, no truncation artifacts)

Scoring guide (notes):
- Faithfulness: check date/numerical facts and named entities only for this pass.
- Concision: penalize >20% extra wording beyond expected summary length.
- Token-coherence: watch for odd characters, broken words (seen w/ int8 sometimes).

Representative samples (copied outputs + quick score):
1) Prompt id 021-fin-synth: 'Summarize the quarterly results for Acme Bank in three bullets.'
   - Model (baseline): "Net revenue grew 4.2% q/q; NIM held at 3.1%; guidance conservative." (3/3/3)
   - Model (current): "Revenue increased; net interest margin dropped slightly; CEO optimistic." -> Issues: lost precise numbers, swapped signal (NIM dropped vs baseline held). (1/3/3)
   - Hypothesis: attention kernel slight variance in numeric retention; verify kv-cache alignment.

2) Prompt id 037-risk-note: 'List top 2 regulatory risks for cross-border payments.'
   - Model (current): returns plausible list but invents 'PSD4' (nonexistent) as a regulation. (0/3/3)
   - Hypothesis: hallucination rate increased on short-form lists. Could be temperature scheduling or a beam/decoding tweak.

3) Prompt id 090-noise-edge: 'What is the exchange rate USD->EUR on 2024-11-01?'
   - Model (current): "0.87" with trailing garbled char "0.87". (3/3/1)
   - Note: token-coherence hit despite factual number — look at int8 decoder outputs for control chars.

Regression patterns observed (initial):
- Numeric fidelity decline: more outputs replace exact numbers with vague qualifiers.
- Entity hallucination on taxonomy-like prompts (regulation names, product SKUs).
- Sporadic control/nontext characters appended (frequency ~0.2% samples); correlates with int8 path on one node type.

Quick checks to run (what I did / next steps):
- Re-run the 100-sample 'finance-summary' suite pinned to CPU-only (no quant) -> sanity ok (numbers preserved).
- Re-run same suite on dedicated-gpu-quant-int8, isolate nodes, reproduce garbled char on node g3-quant-17.
- Set model to deterministic decoding (top_p=0.0, temperature=0.0) on both kernels -> compare exact token traces.

Hypotheses prioritized:
1) Quantization path bug: decoder postprocessing not masking a control byte -> explains garbled char and occasional tokenization collapse. (high priority)
2) Kernel numerical instability: fused-attention slight float differences cause numeric rounding to be lost through multihead mixing -> leads to "lost digits" for numbers. (medium)
3) Decoding defaults changed in rollout (more permissive top_k/top_p) -> increases hallucination on taxonomy prompts. (low/medium)

Short experiment plan (2-day sprint):
- Day 1: narrow reproduction + deterministic runs (Samir) -> confirm which node types reproduce. Add logging to capture raw token ids and decoder pre-softmax logits for first 50 steps.
- Day 2: isolate quant path: compile model with int8 disabled; run smoke; if passes, bisect quant-change commit set. If still fails, run ablation on fused-attention macro.

Notes for handoff / What to include in a Github issue:
- Minimal repro: prompt id 021-fin-synth + seed + config dump. Attach raw token id sequences for baseline vs repro node.
- Attach small perf impact note: disabling quant increased latency by ~8% on bench (not huge but acceptable for rollback if needed).
- Tag: @infra-kernel-team, @applied-ml.

Loose ideas / heuristics I want to keep: 
- Micro-rubric for numbers: treat exact match as score 3, approximate within 2% -> 2, vague qualifier ->1, wrong ->0.
- When a sample shows token garble, capture final 128 token ids and run a UTF-8 sanity check to see if decoder produced invalid byte sequences.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Is there a config drift in default decoding between hosted-release-2024-12 and hosted-release-2025-01? (check release notes)
- Can infra dump the kernel build flags for node g3-quant-17? (ask @Noelle)
- Add a short eval: run 10k finance-summary samples nightly but only diff numeric/entity fields and report aggregated drift. (ask product)

Small checklist for next pass:
- [ ] Create minimal repro ticket with token dumps
- [ ] Run deterministic decode on offending node types
- [ ] Attach quant-int8 build flags and compile-time macros
- [ ] Run quick nightly delta for numbers-only metrics

Final quick thought: this was a fast pass — keep it lightweight. If Samir reproduces the garbled control chars in int8 path, I think rollback of that quant kernel is justified until we have a fix.

(End of scribble — feel free to copy/paste into GH issue or Confluence; don't rely on this as the canonical triage doc.)
